As part of my work, I support the Environmental Monitors on Lobster Traps and 
Large Trawlers (eMOLT) program. eMOLT is a collaborative initiative, where
commercial fishing vessels collect vital oceanographic data. Fishermen deploy 
sensors to record bottom water temperatures and oxygen levels, which helps 
improve regional ocean circulation models and supports adaptive fishing practices. 

The data collected is served back to captains in realtime, providing them with 
oceanographic conditions which they can use to support their fishing decsions.
information.  

Learn more about [eMOLT](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/new-england-mid-atlantic/climate/partnering-fishing-industry-monitor-northeast-shelf)
